title: Crosswalk
description: A bulk mapping between a SAICA-KG axis and an external taxonomy's categories. Complements inline `crosswalks` declared on FailureMode nodes.

reviewed_by.description: People who read every mapping against the source. Leave empty until that has happened.

review_state.description: llm_drafted_unreviewed: drafted by an LLM or an agent, not yet read against the source by a person. human_reviewed: read against the source by the people in reviewed_by.

last_reviewed.description: Date of the last review by the people in reviewed_by.

source_checked_on.description: Date the external ids and labels used in this file were last compared with the primary source, by a person or an agent. This is not a review of the mappings themselves.

saica_value.description: Value on the SAICA axis (e.g., a FailureMode id).

external_id.description: Category id in the external taxonomy.

category.description: external_id of the category in the external taxonomy.

reason.description: Why the category has no mapping on this axis.

items.description: A category of the external taxonomy that this crosswalk leaves out on purpose.

unmapped.description: Categories of the external taxonomy that have no mapping on this axis, each with the reason.
